facts.claim: Anatomy indexed from 'Digital Anatomy of Four Music-Marketing Machines' research report (2026-10-03); per-fact evidence tiers and sources recorded in attrs.key_facts
Flow: upload/link track -> write pitch -> pay credits/budget -> curator inbox -> listen -> decision + feedback -> credit refund if SLA missed

Curator workflow: listen (>=~60s required on SubmitHub premium) -> approve (add to playlist, optionally share) or decline with written reason; low-effort declines hurt curator rating and future submission flow
SubmitHub: per-curator submission -> decision + written feedback (>=10-20 words on decline) within the premium SLA window; credit refunded if SLA missed
Playlist Push: managed campaign (2-4 weeks) -> per-curator qualitative reviews; if Spotify for Artists is connected, a detailed report 30 days after the campaign ends
Dashboard: campaign status, per-curator decisions/feedback, approval rates, spend; Spotify-side verification happens in the artist's own Spotify for Artists (source-of-stream)
